earlier.claim: The default start reads decision records from the working tree under --path, not from HEAD at the repository's top level. An uncommitted newest record, or running from a subdirectory, makes default_since return None and the verb silently lists the whole history.

The words signal misses a phrase that a wrapped commit body splits across lines (instead
of, rather
than, no
longer, switch
to). The prototype folded whitespace before matching, so the verb scores some changes lower than the measured filter did.

new.claim: the reference's exit-code line lists the refusals as "not a git repository, or a --since that names no commit" and leaves out the new no-commits refusal
